summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn after BarColumn, Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, capture in update and advance inside the lock, clearing in _reset and Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with TYPE_CHECKING and in-method imports); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn in test_columns list, and hand-derived expected output updated); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per instructions. The test_columns expected output was derived by hand from a MockClock read trace and verified only by grep counts (bar widths 25 and 16, elapsed values 0:00:37/0:00:36 unfinished and 0:01:00/0:00:45 finished, speed for bar now 1 byte/s). Running test_progress and test_palette is still needed to confirm.
